_comment: Single source of truth for the 2-minute demo video. Times in seconds. Each caption is also the voice-over line. Numbers come from output/NUMBERS.md.

captions.text: Waste is billed per tonne, yet only the hauler, who gets paid, weighs it.
Our demo hotel group: 395 pickups a year, only 48 with a weighing ticket.
The machine knows how full it is. Nobody knows how heavy.

segments.tag: exterior per Europress brochure, internals schematic

captions.text: A Europress compactor already measures its hydraulic ram pressure on every stroke.
Denser, heavier waste pushes back harder. That pressure is our weight signal.
Our soft sensor turns pressure, strokes, oil temperature and weather into kilograms, with an honest range.
Fill level alone is 32 % off. On simulated machines it never saw, ours is 5.3 % off.

shots.what: Customer view, Overview: 'Your machines now' cards with fill % and '≈ kg inside', then scroll to 'SMART can save you €60,471 / year'.
Customer view, 'Weight & seasons' tab: pickup weights with a range and the ticket-vs-machine check (48 of 395 with a ticket).
Customer view, 'Operators & contracts': Hauler Delta vs the second operator (on time 57 % vs 62 %, tickets shared 0 % vs 89 %), 'Data as of 30 Sep 2026' visible.
Customer view, 'Savings': click the €39,955 'empty machines when they are full' lever so the trace drawer opens with formula and data rows.
Switch to 'Europress' workspace, weight sensor 'Weighbridge check' page: predicted vs weighbridge scatter over 4,876 emptyings.
Europress workspace, sales leads / pipeline: open a lead pop-up and press 'Brief me' so the three-sentence brief appears.

captions.text: This is SMART Insights, running on Europress's practice data. Each machine shows its fill level and estimated weight.
Every pickup gets a weight with a range, checked against the weighing ticket wherever one exists.
Contracts become comparable: Hauler Delta is on time 57 % of the time and shares none of its weight data.
Every euro opens to its formula and data rows. Here, €39,955 a year from emptying half-full machines.
For Europress, the weight sensor is checked against weighbridge tickets, emptying by emptying.
Sales get a short brief, written by Claude from cited data, for a person to review.
This hotel group could save about €60,000 of its €140,000 a year, mostly on half-empty pickups.
Across the fleet, pickups with an independent weight rise from 74 % to 97 %.
For Europress, weight makes SMART stickier: one more point of adoption is worth about €21,600 a year.
Another study is less optimistic, so step one is a zero-euro test on archived data.
